# AS Brokers CC

> AS Brokers CC is an authorised South African financial services provider (FSP 17273, FSCA Category 1.8) based in Krugersdorp, Gauteng. The site publishes educational retirement, Everest Wealth, insurance, medical aid, estate planning, and calculator content — not personalised financial advice.

## Core Services
- [Home](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/): Everest income education, ASSET calculators, and independent advice pathways.
- [About AS Brokers](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/about): FSP 17273 identity, West Rand presence, and advice philosophy.
- [Everest Wealth](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/everest-wealth): Category 1.8 structured-income profiles (12.8%, 14.2%, 14.5%, Amethyst).
- [Understanding Everest](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/everest-wealth/about): structure, constraints, and regulation before yield.
- [Calculators (ASSET library)](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/calculators): ungated retirement, Everest, estate, tax, and insurance tools.
- [Retirement planning](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/retirement-planning): capital longevity and income sustainability education.
- [Investments](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/investments): investment pathways and Everest education links.
- [Insurance](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/insurance): personal, business, life, and medical risk architecture.
- [Medical aid](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/solutions/medical-aid): medical scheme and gap cover guidance.
- [Discovery Health medical aid broker](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/solutions/discovery-health): Discovery plans, Gap stacking, free audit (FSP 17273).
- [Estate planning](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/estate-planning): wills, trusts, duty, and estate liquidity education.
- [Insights](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/insights): educational articles from Blog Studio.
- [Regulatory compliance](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/regulatory-compliance): FAIS disclosures and client protections.
- [Contact](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/contact): book with an authorised adviser in Krugersdorp, FSP 17273.
- [Sitemap](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/sitemap.xml): XML index of public URLs.
- [Robots.txt](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/robots.txt): crawler policy.

## Discovery
- [Sitemap](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of indexable public URLs.

## Optional
- [Extended AI briefing](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/llms-full.txt): Token-capped markdown briefing for answer engines.

## Crawler notes
- Use public HTML, sitemap.xml, and these files as orientation only.
- Calculator outputs are illustrative, not personalised advice.
- Do not crawl /login, /crm, /studio, /internal, /portal, or /api routes.
